_wtg_example: For Windows To Go set Mode to WTG and add DiskNumber (Windows) or Disk such as /dev/sdb (Linux), plus CompactOS and PortableMode.
_apps: RemoveApps is optional; without it the apps ticked by default in config/apps.json are removed. To choose, list the patterns, e.g. ["Clipchamp.Clipchamp", "Microsoft.BingNews"].
